title: HTC Announces New Privacy-Focused Smart Glasses
excerpt: HTC has introduced new smart glasses offering features similar to Meta devices while operating independently of social media platforms.
body_html:
HTC has introduced a new pair of smart glasses designed to offer an alternative to existing devices on the market. According to details released about the product, these glasses provide functionality comparable to Meta's smart glasses.

However, a key distinction of the HTC device is that it operates without being tied to a social media platform, offering users a more private experience.
